title: Find Hooks
description: Retrieves a list of existing hooks in your workspace. Useful for managing active webhooks tied to chat events or deployments.

## Usage

console.log(result)`}

-H "Authorization: Bearer $V0_API_KEY" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json"`}
